title: A Regime-Activated Lensing Response Improves the Fit to KiDS-1000 Cosmic Shear and Reframes the Interpretation of S8
abstract: Tests a phenomenological, regime-activated lensing response Σ(k,z) that modifies how matter fluctuations source shear, applied to KiDS-1000 cosmic shear. Finds a large maximum-likelihood improvement over ΛCDM at fixed cosmology that cannot be mimicked by a simple amplitude rescaling, with a distinct low-redshift tomographic signature that reframes the S8 tension as a response effect.
